bibliographic.title: The Comrade General...
bibliographic.author: Vyner Vanderhumeken
bibliographic.description:
"Isn't this supposed to be beautiful? Isn't this supposed to be art!? This is just a picture of an ass with ears!!"

Nervously an aide whispers: "Comrade General, that's a mirror."
